svg.title: DNA double helix: two synthetic strands from PDB 1BNA
svg.desc: Original projection of 486 deposited heavy-atom coordinates. Chain A is gold and chain B cyan. Each synthetic strand contains 12 nucleotides, the repeating chemical units of DNA; together they form 12 base pairs. Solid sticks show covalent connections within each strand; dashed lines show 32 deposited hydrogen-bond contacts between strands. Water, symmetry neighbours and hydrogens are absent. Symbols are illustrative, not measured surfaces. This fragment is not a patient genome or tumour sample. Coordinate data: RCSB PDB 1BNA, CC0; Drew and colleagues, 1981, doi:10.1073/pnas.78.4.2179.
svg.metadata: Source: https://files.rcsb.org/download/1BNA.cif; SHA-256: 76d550f32963de46f4f3c63caacb530f91a24f333fbc4312766d240b14e8cf30; retrieved 2026-11-05. Deterministic projection generated by assets/models/derive.py.
svg.text: 486 deposited heavy atoms · PDB 1BNA · static projection
Dots: atoms. Solid: covalent bonds. Dashed: hydrogen contacts.
